_note: Real requests to an AI agent working in a project that has al-design-system installed. Each id is the file name of its answers. The runner appends the same output instruction to every prompt (run.mjs, OUTPUT).

tasks.prompt: Build the sign-in page of our product: email, password, a 'Keep me signed in' option, the sign-in button and a link to recover the password.
Build the sign-up form: full name, email, a password the person creates (show the requirements: at least 8 characters, one number), accept the terms, and create the account.
Build a notification settings page: email notifications, push notifications and a weekly summary, each turned on or off with immediate effect, plus a language choice (English, Portuguese, Spanish).
Build a projects page with a 'Delete project' button that opens a confirmation dialog: it says the deletion can't be undone, and offers Cancel and Delete.
Build a list of 10 customer orders (number, customer, status, total) with the status shown as a colored label and pagination at the bottom for 12 pages.
Build the search results page for the case where the search for 'blue sneakers' found nothing: say so, explain why it may have happened, and offer to clear the filters.
Build the payment step of a checkout: card holder name, card number, expiry date, number of installments (1 to 6) and a Pay button. Show it after a failed submit: the card number is invalid.
Build a dashboard with three summary cards (revenue, new customers, open tickets) and below them tabs Overview, Reports and Settings, with the Overview panel open.

Build the layout of our web app: main navigation on the left (Home, Projects, Team, Billing, Settings, with Projects current) and, in the content area, the page title 'Website redesign' under the path Projects > Clients > Website redesign.
Build a product review form: a star rating from 1 to 5, a title, the review text, whether you would recommend it (yes or no), and submit.
Build a file upload screen showing a report.pdf upload at 60%, and the message that appears in the corner when an upload finishes: 'report.pdf uploaded'.
Build a team members table (name with avatar, role, email) where each row has an actions button that opens a menu with Edit, Resend invite and Remove.
